Resolves #21665

Part of #21541: its AC-1. AC-3's receipts follow on later pull requests.

One classify run now serves every engine test tier. A workflow cannot read another workflow's job outputs, so `test-e2e.yml` folds into `test.yml` behind its single `changes` job (`select_e2e: true`). Unit, components and the e2e engine tier keep their own jobs, gates and checks, and still run in parallel. An e2e red reads as `e2e-engine`, never as `unit` or `components`.

- The classifier keeps the e2e selection's skip reason apart (`e2e_skip_reason`), so the components gate never prints it. Its e2e boundary admits `test.yml` instead of the retired file (Vega's catch).
- A dispatch names the e2e tier with `suite: e2e`. An empty suite still runs only unit, unit-tz and components.
- The e2e job reuses the file's `current-pr-head` anchor instead of its own copy of the head check.

Evidence: L2 (unit specs over the committed YAML) and L3 (this pull request's own run exercises the merged workflow) → L3 required (AC-1). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #21541.

## For the merge decision

#18408 moved the e2e tier into its own pipeline on operator direction: "it would need to be an own pipeline, that takes no longer than 5m". This keeps it a separate set of parallel jobs and checks, each shard under its six-minute step ceiling, and shares only the workflow file and its one classification. If "own pipeline" meant its own workflow, this should not merge.

One cost: on a pull request that reaches e2e paths, unit and components now also wait for the e2e selection inside the classify job (a checkout, a Node setup and the selection script). AC-3's push-to-green receipts measure it against the runner it saves.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | One `Classify test scope` job per push on this pull request's run, against two on #21657's. Unit arms hold the shape: `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` (one caller with `select_e2e: true`, each gate's own reason, the dispatch conditions) and `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` (the full matrix and the engine job's `--engine-paths` run, read from `test.yml`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- The fold needed a classifier change the ticket did not name: with one caller asking for the selection, the components gate would have printed the e2e selection's skip reason.
- `test.yml` is now e2e-relevant, so a pull request editing it runs all three tiers; the spec arm that said otherwise is flipped.
- `WhiteboxE2E.md` names the new home of the tier and its dispatch.

## Test Evidence
`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/`: 1426 passed. In a fresh worktree, 29 build-tooling arms fail until `npm run bundle-browser-deps` writes `dist/`; on the `dev` checkout, which has it, those specs pass 43 of 43. The workflow arms pinned the old two-file shape and moved with it; their assertions on the gates, head checks and dispatch caps are unchanged in substance.
